source_title: Paul Anthony Kelly Says His Wife Is ‘Thrilled’ About His Sexiest Man Alive Centerfold (Exclusive) - People.com
source_excerpt:
The ‘American Horror Story’ actor reveals his wife was the only person he told about the honor ahead of the reveal
Paul Anthony Kelly tells PEOPLE why he kept his Sexiest Man Alive honor a secret from his family
The American Horror Story actor says his wife was the only person he told ahead of the announcement
Kelly, who rose to fame playing John F. Kennedy Jr. in Love Story , admits he never imagined receiving the recognition
Paul Anthony Kelly ’s wife is delighted that he was named one of PEOPLE’s Sexiest Men Alive .
While promoting the 13th season of American Horror Story , the Love Story actor, 38, tells PEOPLE he kept the sexy honor under wraps from nearly everyone in his life. “I didn’t tell anybody other than my wife when I did it,” Kelly says. He’s this year’s centerfold in the issue, out now.
While keeping the news to himself wasn’t necessarily easy, the actor admits there was another reason he didn’t rush to share the exciting announcement. “Hard secret, yeah. But also, you know, I don’t want to gloat,” he says with a laugh.
His wife, Syd Widziszewski-Kelly was excited to learn about the recognition, he says: “Yeah, my wife’s thrilled. It was great.”
For the Canadian-born actor, who spent years pursuing an acting career before landing his breakout role as John F. Kennedy Jr. in Ryan Murphy ’s Love Story , the honor is something he never could have anticipated.
“I mean, it’s such an honor to be celebrated in this as, you know, one of the Sexiest Men Alive,” he says. “Never in my wildest dreams did I think I’d ever be in this position, or an actor, or any of these things. You know, you’re just striving for it, and then all these wonderful extras come along.”
The recognition marks another milestone in what has been a whirlwind year. In a previous interview with PEOPLE, Kelly recalled nearly giving up on his Hollywood dreams after years of unsuccessful auditions.
“I’d done a couple auditions, and nothing really came out of them,” he said. “We were thinking about the future and contemplating having a family and what the next steps were.”
He remembered telling his wife, “I don’t think this is going to happen. It’s been this long. I don’t know if this is for me.” But Widziszewski-Kelly encouraged him to keep going. “Well, we’re here, so keep at it,” she told him. That persistence eventually paid off in a life-changing series of events.
On the couple’s second wedding anniversary, Widziszewski-Kelly surprised him with two positive pregnancy tests while they were posing in an old-school photo booth after dinner.
Just two days later, Kelly received his green card, and he subsequently learned during the chemistry read and screen test process that he had landed the role of Kennedy in Love Story . “My whole life changed then,” he previously told PEOPLE. “Still, to this day, I’m flabbergasted that it actually happened, and I’m living my dream.”
Kelly got his start in the entertainment industry after being discovered by modeling scouts while working at American Apparel in Toronto. Though he hadn’t initially planned on becoming a model, the opportunity allowed him to travel the world and eventually led him to his future wife.
The couple met during a modeling shoot in Alaska, where Widziszewski-Kelly was working as a member of the production team.
“We met each other on this job, and it was just like, ‘Oh, s---. Hi. How are you?’” he previously recalled.
After the shoot, Kelly reached out to her through Instagram, despite admitting that making the first move wasn’t typically his style. “It’s not my style at all, but I just couldn’t stop thinking about her,” he said. “I was like, ‘Hey, do you like stuff?’ Then, for about three months, we talked every day.”
The couple married in May 2023 and welcomed their first child in early 2026.
Kelly’s Love Story costar Sarah Pidgeon, who played Carolyn Bessette in the series, didn’t know about his Sexiest Man Alive centerfold until it was publicly announced either. “No, he kept it a secret,” the actress, 30, told PEOPLE at the Time100 Next Gala on Thursday, Oct. 29. “We asked him about that [on a recent call]. I think he logged on and was like, ‘Hey, Sexiest Man.’ And he knew about it since August or something? Yeah, he didn’t tell a soul.”
